notes: Event date: CMH The Last Offensive ch. 17 p. 400: "That was Panzer Division von Clausewitz, formed from staff and students of a panzer training school off the Ninth Army's flank near Uelzen"; "The first indication of the presence of Panzer Division von Clausewitz emerged on 15 April when the British identified a portion of the division in a counterattack at Uelzen". current_activity: US 5th Armored Division destroys the last of Panzer Division von Clausewitz on 21 April in the Klötze area
notes: Event date: CMH The Last Offensive ch. 17 p. 400: "a force estimated at a thousand men and thirty tanks cut the main supply route of the XIII Corps near General Gillem's command post at Kloetze"; p. 401: "When the attack finally began on the 21st, the 5th Armored Division encountered and destroyed the last of Panzer Division von Clausewitz". Event definition: the destruction on 21 April; contingents had raided the corps rear from 16 April. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Klötze, Sachsen-Anhalt with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: Klötze stands for the rear area of the US XIII Corps in which the division was destroyed; the last fight is not placed by name. Location support: CMH names Klötze as the place of the first raid and of the forest fight; it does not place the last fight on 21 April. Commander: unknown. Opponents: US 5th Armored Division, 29th Division.
